title: backend_schema
objective: Initialize SQLite schema for Events and Tunes
acceptance_criteria: Event schema uses UUID for setlists 1:1;Tune schema implements CAS SHA-256 media_hash;Both tables implement updated_at and deleted_at tombstones

title: backend_cas
objective: Implement Content-Addressable Storage for media blobs
acceptance_criteria: Save blobs addressed by SHA-256 digest;Serve immutable binary payloads independent of JSON entities;Isolate transport from relational sync

title: backend_sync
acceptance_criteria: Accept JSON push for Events/Tunes;Resolve conflicts via unconditional Last-Write-Wins using updated_at;Process deleted_at tombstones

title: frontend_db
acceptance_criteria: Create Events table matching PRD schema;Create Tunes table with transform_data and annotation_data;Enforce <1000 record constraint logic

title: frontend_sync
acceptance_criteria: Push local modifications to backend;Pull remote modifications and overwrite local state unconditionally via LWW;Handle tombstone deletions

title: ingest_pdf
objective: Extract first page of uploaded PDFs
acceptance_criteria: Truncate multi-page PDFs silently;Extract Page 1 as media asset;Hash extracted page using SHA-256

title: ingest_abc
objective: Render ABC notation to static SVG
acceptance_criteria: Parse ABC string input;Render to static SVG to guarantee visual uniform pipeline;Hash output using SHA-256

title: event_view
objective: Implement split-pane Event and Setlist view
acceptance_criteria: Render left column Events sorted by date desc;Render right column Event details;Display scrollable 1:1 setlist linked to Event

title: setlist_search
acceptance_criteria: Fuzzy match against primary_title and alternate_titles;Provide instant visual feedback on string input;Append selected Tune UUID to Event.tune_ids

title: performance_view
objective: Implement minimal lead sheet viewer and Wake Lock
acceptance_criteria: Acquire Screen Wake Lock API explicitly on mount;Release Wake Lock on unmount or visibility loss;Render system status bar and back button

title: tune_transform
objective: Implement non-destructive crop and rotate UI
acceptance_criteria: Apply CSS/Canvas transforms based on transform_data;Permanently hard-disable inputs if annotation_data is non-null

title: annotation_draw
acceptance_criteria: Capture stroke normalized coordinates (0.0 to 1.0);Isolate swipe navigation input from annotation rendering;Maintain session-level undo/redo stack

title: annotation_lasso
acceptance_criteria: Toggle UI between Draw and Lasso;Execute ray-casting on closed polygon to select stroke centroids;Allow moving/deleting selected strokes
